outcome: intraoperative cell salvage (ICS) associated adverse events
cohort: The study included 50 Japanese women who received intraoperative cell salvage (ICS) blood during obstetric surgery, primarily for placenta previa, between 2007 and 2013.
finding: Intraoperative cell salvage (ICS) blood reinfusion caused no adverse events in women at elevated risk of peripartum hemorrhage and was associated with 66% of women not requiring allogeneic blood transfusion.
